summary: Play piano like a PRO. Easy to use, Audio lessons, Make friends, Chat & Have fun
description: No experience? No Problem! Real Piano Teacher is a fast and easy to use Piano app, with an intelligent and fun way to learn piano from a total beginner to PRO. Make friends while learning, Share your progress & performances, Interact with friends & online tutors, ask questions, get 24/7 support, play fun games & quizzes all for free Comes with midi support and allows you to connect to a real piano and get instant feedback when you hit the right/wrong keys Don’t have a real piano? Don’t worry; you can use the in-built touch piano for an immersive experience. Learn sheet music quickly with over 200 instruments. Piano lessons covers beginners to advanced with full offline audio lessons in various languages & accents Learn to play the piano with zero experience with this fun educational piano. The interactive piano tutors and teachers assume you are a total beginner however this app is equally suited for intermediate and advanced musicians & pianists Play any music, chord, melodies in this interactive and very simple to use piano app The app listens to every note you play and gives you instant feedback so you know if you hit the correct note at the right time. All notes are perfectly synced with hundreds of free top songs Features include: ★★LEARNING MODE★★ In learning mode, you can learn how to play the piano for free! Master each lesson in a fun and interactive way. Real Piano Teacher supports USB Midi Keyboard and supports standard general Midi protocol which allows the connection of a real physical piano or Midi keyboard such Yamaha, Casio etc or any real keyboard. By connecting to a physical midi keyboard, you can control, play, record and compete via the external MIDI keyboard From playing single notes to complete pieces, this perfect piano helps you master sight-reading, technique, rhythm and playing with both hands to make sheet music come to life. Piano lessons include how to position your fingers on the piano, understanding the elements of the keyboard, groupings & naming of the various keys, notes for each position, staffs, clefs and chords. Then, you’re going to learn about notes, chords, play tons of amazing classical pieces, as well as contemporary hit songs on your own keyboard or the touch piano. After taking the piano lessons, you'll learn how to read notes, play while reading sheet music and play any song like a PRO ★★GAME MODE★★ You will play fun games that are designed to train your relevant senses such as hand-coordination, musical hearing, sense of rhythm and many other skills. Compete with friends and family, break world records in the leader board. You can play the magic piano game with any song. Some pre-loaded songs include Twinkle little stars, Jingle Bells, Mozart, Beethoven, green sleeves, canon, merry Christmas, silent night, rap, disco, country music with this best piano game etc ★★MAGIC KEYS and FREESTYLE★★ You can play and create freestyle music with this perfect piano. You can tap any key to play music in Magic keys mode. Get creative, record, & share with friends and family with the best android game. Add loops, beats to any song you compose and upload to Piano party. Play any song without practice. OTHER FEATURES • Fun and interactive tutor to teach you with audio and offline speech • Social network - Make friends, Share your performance, Play the piano with other players all over the world • Over 200 other instruments to play like Grand piano, Guitar, drums, Organ, Xylophone • Single-row, Double-row mode, Sustain Pedal Feature • Piano Connect functionality – Connect with real piano for realistic experience • Gaming, Learning & Freestyle modes • 8 Full Octaves (Key/Note Types) Permissions RECORD AUDIO Allows you to make Piano recordings ACCESS PHOTOS & MEDIA Allows you to download Piano Audio lessons on to device. Allows you to set your profile or cover photo LOCATION Get device country location for "Nearby" feature so other players can see shared recordings
